facts.material: PVC (4 mm base, 0.5 mm backing) with 0.5 mm decorative wood veneer layer

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3918 floor coverings of plastics in the form of tiles; PVC is >90% of thickness so plastic gives essential character
GRI 3(b): composite, PVC base/backing gives essential character over thin wood veneer
GRI 6: 3918.10 polymers of vinyl chloride, 3918.10.10 vinyl tile, rigid core suffix

rejected_alternatives.reason: wood flooring panels; wood is only 0.5 mm of 5 mm, not essential character
other vinyl tile; rigid solid PVC core assumed

missing_facts: Whether the PVC core is rigid solid or expanded
classification.rationale: Nearly all thickness is PVC, so heading 3918.10 vinyl tile; click-lock rigid PVC base assumed solid polymer core. Wood flooring rulings found did not match the facts so none is cited.
